item.title: Jane Fonda warns America faces 'existential' crisis as she urges turnout at 'No Kings' protests
item.summary: Jane Fonda urges Americans to join the "No Kings" protests, suggesting they bring five new people and warning the country faces "existential" threats under Trump.

item.title: Zelenskyy offers cutting-edge drone defense to Gulf allies as Ukraine seeks missile support
item.summary: Ukraine's president offered the country's counter-drone technology to Gulf nations, seeking missile support as Ukraine faces a critical air defense deficit.

item.title: Slain college student’s mother vows ‘fight for justice’ after illegal immigrant charged in Chicago killing
item.summary: Sheridan Gorman, 18, was allegedly shot and killed near Loyola University Chicago by Jose Medina-Medina, an illegal immigrant from Venezuela, according to authorities.

item.title: Far-left California congressional candidate clashes with Trump supporters in heated exchange
item.summary: Shonique Williams confronted Trump supporters at Cerritos College, where a heated exchange over politics, race and policy escalated into a campus free speech area.

item.title: Illinois knocks off Iowa to reach Final Four after buzzer malfunction delay
item.summary: Illinois rolled past Iowa in Saturday's Elite Eight in the South Regional, punching the Fighting Illini's first Final Four ticket since 2005 despite a buzzer delay.

item.title: New study reveals most stressed US states, and they aren't where you'd expect
item.summary: A new WalletHub study ranks Louisiana as the most stressed U.S. state in 2026, citing poverty, limited health care access and high unemployment rates.

item.title: Nate Smith admits he threw a drink at Morgan Wallen on stage, calling him 'a very forgiving person'
item.summary: Nate Smith admits he threw a drink at Morgan Wallen on stage during their tour, saying Wallen forgave him and that he thought he was being funny.

item.title: UConn's Geno Auriemma unloads on NCAA over tournament format: 'I just don't understand'
item.summary: UConn women's basketball coach Geno Auriemma blasted the NCAA over its two-site regional format, saying that poor shootaround times and new equipment hurt the quality of play.

item.title: 'Quad God' Ilia Malinin avenges Olympic disappointment with backflip for third straight world title
item.summary: Ilia Malinin rebounded from Olympic disappointment to win a third straight world title, showcasing resilience and dominance on the ice.

item.title: Jeffries declines to break with indicted Democrat after ethics panel's guilty verdict
item.summary: Rep. Sheila Cherfilus-McCormick was found guilty of over two dozen ethics violations, but Democratic leaders have so far withheld condemnation.
